summary: Retest #2 of AiAnalyst reset-during-stream crash. Fix is now present in /app/frontend/src/components/AiAnalyst.jsx (AbortController via abortRef, guarded token append, AbortError ignored, ai-reset always clickable). Verified end-to-end via UI: (a) rapid reset ~1s after clicking suggestion — messages cleared, suggestions re-rendered, NO 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay, no console TypeError, no pageerror; repeated twice successfully. (b) Typing 'Quantos influencers ativos?' via ai-input+ai-send streams and completes cleanly in ~5s (533 chars). (c) ai-reset after completion clears state cleanly. Bug FIXED.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: abortRef.current?.abort() in reset() cancels the reader, and the setMsgs token append now guards on last message being an assistant, so late tokens after reset are safely dropped.
Minor: after abort, the reader loop's reader.read() throws AbortError which is caught in the outer try/catch (name check on line 43) — clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AiAnalyst reset-during-stream is fixed. If regressions appear, rerun the rapid_reset_test flow from this iteration: login → /admin → click first ai-suggestion → sleep 900ms → click ai-reset → assert no overlay & suggestions visible.
rca of the issue: Fixed by main agent. Root cause was two-fold: (1) reset() cleared msgs=[] but didn't cancel the SSE fetch reader, so late token events tried to append to c[c.length-1] on an empty array; (2) the token-append setMsgs did not guard for msgs.length or last-role==='assistant'. Both are now addressed via AbortController in ask()/reset() and a guarded setMsgs updater.
